records.prompt: Use case: lighting-weather. Edit target image 1: the transparent BPC-157 vial. Image 2 is ONLY an environment lighting reference; do not include it in output. Produce a single relit vial on genuine transparent background, square canvas, same centered frontal position and same relative dimensions as image 1. Preserve exact vial geometry, black cap, silver metal collar, and ALL label artwork and lettering unchanged: BPC-157, 10 MG, FOR RESEARCH USE ONLY. Relight glass/cap to naturally belong in image 2's warm champagne-gray cinematic environment: replace stark white studio strips with softer champagne reflections, deeper charcoal left reflection, restrained ivory right reflection, realistic warm environmental bounce in glass base and shoulder. Clearly noticeable professional relighting, not a generic sepia filter. Label remains neutral ivory and crisp with original typography and design. Preserve transparent cutout and no exterior halo. No particles, floor, cast shadow, background, pedestal, additional objects, text or crop. Actual alpha transparency required, no checkerboard printed into image.
